professionalSummary: Data Engineering professional with 4+ years of total software development experience and a focus on building data pipelines and analytics-ready datasets using Snowflake, SQL, Python, PySpark, Snowpark, and dbt. Familiar with AWS S3 for cloud-based data storage and Bronze, Silver, and Gold layers for data processing. Experienced in data transformation, data validation, and preparing structured datasets for analytics and reporting. A full-stack development background in React, React Native, and Node.js provides an understanding of end-to-end application and data workflows.
